recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-50127 unless a future work group issue separately addresses source site versus specimen type guidance.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 OO issue requesting replacement of the old Observation.specimen comment that discouraged use when the specimen was implicit in Observation.code. The accepted wording says the element SHOULD be used when the observation is performed on a specimen and the specimen type SHOULD be consistent with anything implied by Observation.code.
initial_application: The source update was already present before this reconciliation. Commit 21683fadd8 replaced the old comment with the accepted specimen guidance, and commit 1b060a6f4f changed the conformance words to uppercase SHOULD after QA feedback linked from PR #3556.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists observation=Observation under [resources], confirming the StructureDefinition is in build scope. OO WGM minutes page 345083413 record FHIR-50127 as persuasive with modification with a 14-0-0 vote. The Jira PR #3556 comment explains that bold styling was not possible in the conformance text, so plain uppercase SHOULD is appropriate. Direct Zulip search found no conflicting FHIR-50127 discussion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml already says: SHOULD be used when the observation is performed on a specimen. The type of specimen SHOULD be consistent with anything implied in the `Observation.code` value. The old implicit-code warning text is absent, and the combined branch contains the same source state.
